description: Agent-Nuvira command manifest — maps plain-English intents to CLI commands. Feed this file (or the docs/COMMANDS.md it mirrors) to the agent so it can execute any task by running the right 'buff' command.
note: Ambiguous asks are represented by entries sharing an 'ambiguityGroup'; the router must ask the user which group member they mean before executing.

intents.objective: Launch the web UI (Agent Hub, Channels, Tasks, Chat, Gateway ops, Admin)
Gracefully stop a running dashboard from any terminal
Run all configured adapters so the agent answers on WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord/Slack/Email/Signal
Gracefully SIGTERM a running gateway from any terminal

intents.summary: Show gateway status and reachable channels
intents.objective: See which platforms are configured and which channels are reachable

intents.summary: Send a message to a channel
intents.objective: Send a one-shot message to an alias or platform:channelId
intents.example: nuvira gateway send ops "nightly build done"

intents.summary: Send a media file to a channel
intents.objective: Send an image/video/audio/document to a channel
Give a channel a friendly name so 'buff gateway send <alias>' works
intents.example: nuvira gateway alias add ops slack C0123

intents.objective: Delete a registered channel alias

intents.summary: Add a person to a WhatsApp/sender contact list
intents.objective: AMBIGUOUS — two lists exist. The router MUST ask which one: (a) verified list = the number can TRIGGER the agent; (b) send-by-name mapping = you can send TO them by name.

resolutions.when: trigger / respond to / message the bot / verified list
resolutions.command: nuvira config gateway allow whatsapp user <number>
resolutions.example: nuvira config gateway allow whatsapp user 919958604222
resolutions.summary: Verified list — the number may trigger the agent

resolutions.when: send by name / send to them / send-by-name mapping
resolutions.summary: Send-by-name mapping — lets YOU send to them by name (does NOT grant trigger access)

intents.summary: Remove a person from a WhatsApp/sender contact list
intents.objective: AMBIGUOUS — remove from the verified (trigger) list or the send-by-name mapping. Router must ask which.

resolutions.when: block / stop them messaging / verified list
resolutions.command: nuvira config gateway disallow whatsapp user <number>
resolutions.example: nuvira config gateway disallow whatsapp user 919958604222
resolutions.summary: Remove from verified list — they can no longer trigger the agent

intents.objective: Show the resolvable send-by-name contacts (numbers masked on screen)

intents.summary: Allow a user/group to trigger the agent on a platform
intents.objective: Add a sender to the verified (trigger) list on a platform. Blank list = no one may trigger; 'Allow-All' = everyone.
intents.example: nuvira config gateway allow whatsapp user 919958604222

intents.summary: Remove a user/group from the allowed list
intents.objective: Remove a sender from the verified (trigger) list on a platform
intents.example: nuvira config gateway disallow whatsapp user 919958604222

intents.summary: Set how unapproved senders are handled
intents.objective: polite = refusal message; silent = drop with no reply (default)
intents.example: nuvira config gateway reply whatsapp silent

intents.summary: Manage status recipients (always get completion summaries)
intents.objective: Contacts/groups that ALWAYS receive pipeline completion summaries
intents.example: nuvira config gateway notify add whatsapp:Alex slack:ops

intents.example: nuvira config gateway set telegram --set BUFF_TELEGRAM_TOKEN=123456789:AAH...

intents.objective: Remove a platform transport from the env file
